ideas.title: Minnesota Social Services Fraud Report Redacted
ideas.description: Investigate the reasons behind the redaction of the Minnesota social services fraud report and potential implications.
questions: What are the implications for accountability?
ideas.insight: The redaction of the report suggests potential lack of transparency and accountability in Minnesota's social services.

ideas.title: MiLEAP Child Care Program Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the inefficiencies and potential fraud within MiLEAP's child care program.
questions: How did the program fail thousands of providers?
ideas.insight: The program's inefficiencies and potential fraud indicate a need for closer monitoring and oversight.
